description:
A family home, set in a gorgeous location with front and rear gardens, ideal entertaining and socialising . Just a stones throw away from Redland station and a short walk away from an abundance of fabulous shops and cafes on Whiteladies Road. Offered on an unfurnished basis with white goods included and available mid September.

Council Tax Band: D
Holding Deposit: £687.69
Dilapidations Deposit: £3,438.46

Set in the popular Redland location with a host of schools nearby, perfect for families relocating to the area. Whiteladies Road and the popular Gloucester Road are just a short distance away too, with lots of shops and cafes perfect for a Sunday stroll.

This property is split over two levels and has plenty of space for all, with four great sized bedrooms and two bathrooms this truly is a great offering. On the lower ground floor, there is a generously sized kitchen with integrated appliances, shared with the dining room that has patio doors leading out to the gorgeous low maintenance garden with Astro turf towards that far rear. There are also two bedrooms and a shower room with w/c and basin. A utility room completes this level. 

On the ground floor there are two further bedrooms with tall ceilings and great period features including beautiful bay windows that fill the room with lots of natural light. There is a further bathroom with w/c and basin. To the front of the property is a generously sized lounge space with a large piano that might be perfect for one that may be learning to play. There is also a second reception room off the lounge that could be perfect for a home office, ideal for working from home and overlooks the beautiful front garden. 

This home is perfect for a professional family looking for their next abode to call home. Pets Consideredand and offered on an unfurnished basis, available mid September. Managed by CJ Hole. Call today to arrange your viewing.
